RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, July 27, 2010/Sravana 5, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Finance; Health and Family Welfare; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Panchayati Raj; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Rural Development; Shipping)
Total number of questions — 20
7
Sale of shares of Public Sector Banks
*21. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some of the
Public Sector Banks are going to sell their
shares to the public during this fiscal year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government had assessed
the market about the sale price of the shares;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether Government has decided
the sale of banks' shares on auction basis;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) if not, the reasons therefor?
Decontrol of petro-products' prices
*22. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has decided to decontrol the prices of the
petroleum products;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether it is also a fact that it will
lead to monopoly of the oil companies?
Disbursement of credit to private and
public sector undertakings
*23. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister
of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the total gross new credit disbursed
during 2008-09 and 2009-10 by various
banks to private and public sector
undertakings (PSUs) separately, year-wise
and sector-wise; and
(b) how much of the credit to the private
sector was linked to the Government or
PSUs risk/contracts?
Implementation of MGNREGS
*24. PROF. ANIL KUMAR SAHANI:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether only 42, 48 and 51 days
per household of employment on an
average could be provided to the job seeking
households under Mahatma Gandhi
National Rural Employment Guarantee

8
Scheme (MGNREGS) during 2007-08,
2008-09 and 2009-10 respectively;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether only 9 per cent of
households were provided 100 days
employment during 2009-10 under the
Scheme;
(d) the steps taken to provide more
funds to the Scheme to achieve its intended
objectives;
(e) whether funds meant for the Scheme
have been diverted and used for other
purposes; and
(f) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken against the unscrupulous officials?
Price hike of petroleum products
*25. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has increased
the prices of petrol, diesel, kerosene and
Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) recently;
(b) if so, the details of increase, item-
wise;
(c) the details of price hike of petroleum
products during the last fourteen months
till date, item-wise;
(d) whether this price rise would lead
to increase in inflation and price rise of
essential commodities which is already very
high; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the
corrective measures taken or to be taken in
this regard?
Surging inflation rate
*26. SHRI N.K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the plight of the common
man reeling under the impact of rising prices
has worsened with the inflation rate surging
into double digits recently;
(b) if so, whether the various strategies
and policies of Government have
completely failed to contain the rising
prices;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the details of new initiatives
Government proposes to take to control
or check inflation?
Air mishaps in the country
†*27. SHRI A VINASH RAI
KHANNA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of air mishaps and the
details of losses incurred therein during the
last three years;
(b) whether any investigation has been
conducted for Mangalore air mishap;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the action being taken by
Government to prevent recurrence of such
mishaps?
New world class airports in the
country
*28. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister  of CIVIL  A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has taken a
decision of making new world class Indian
airports, like Delhi T-3, global aviation hubs
giving an impetus to the Aviation Ministry's
long delayed proposal of allowing foreign
airlines to take up to 26 per cent stake in
domestic carrier;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

9
(c) if not, by when a final decision
would be taken?
Terminal-3 at IGI airport
†*29. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Terminal-3 at Indira Gandhi
International Airport was inaugurated on
3 July, 2010 and operation of flights was
to be started from there on 31 July, 2010;
(b) whether it is a fact that now date of
operation has been fixed as 27 August, 2010;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether it is a fact that water had
accumulated at various places on
Terminal-3; and
(e) if so, the steps taken by Government
to prevent reoccurrence of such situation
in future?
Taxes on petro-products
†*30. SHRIMATI MAY A SINGH: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the taxes being levied by
Government on petroleum products at
present;
(b) the details of per barrel price rise of
crude petroleum products in international
market during the last three years; and
(c) the details of price rise of the same
effected by Government?
Export/import of petroleum products
by private oil companies
*31. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the product-wise and total quantity-
wise major petroleum product(s) exported/
imported by all private oil companies during
the last three years, year-wise;
(b) the quantity of major petroleum
products, product-wise and total quantity-
wise that was domestically sold by private
companies in India during this period; and
(c) the average retail prices at which the
petrol and diesel were sold by various
private companies operating in the country
during the last three years, year-wise?
Shortage of doctors at AIIMS Trauma
Centre
*32. SHRI A. ELAV ARASAN: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that patients at
the All India Institute of Medical Sciences
(AIIMS) Trauma Centre have been
suffering due to shortage of specialist
doctors;
(b) whether it is also a fact that about
40 per cent of the sanctioned posts are
lying vacant and demand for creation of
new posts had not been fulfilled at AIIMS;
(c)  if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the details of steps initiated by
Government to appoint adequate specialist
doctors at AIIMS Trauma Centre?
Cadre review in IRS
*33. SHRI RAMA CHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the stage at which the proposals of
cadre reviews for the IRS(IT) and IRS
(C&CE) are pending;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

10
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) whether Government had asked all
organized services to undertake cadre
reviews within one year of the notification
of Sixth Central Pay Commission awards;
and
(c) whether there has been a delay in
respect of the cadre review in IRS(IT) and
IRS(C&CE)?
Gradation of hospitals
*34. DR. JANARDHAN
WAGHMARE: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes
grading of the hospitals (A, B, C, D), both
public and private, taking into consideration
the facilities and specialization, in order to
fix the range of hospital charges;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Emission of radiation by cell phone
towers
*35. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the health of
people is affected due to the radiation
emitted from the cell phone towers;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Restructuring of SGSY
*36. SHRI NAND KUMAR SAI: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
restructure the existing Centrally sponsored
scheme ‘Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar
Yojana' (SGSY);
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) the objectives of the new scheme;
(d) whether Government has made any
evaluation/research on the restructured
scheme;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) the details of funds allocated for new
schemes during the remaining period of
current Five Y ear Plan period?
Frequent hikes in prices of petro-
products
†*37. SHRI RUDRA NARAY AN
PANY: Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) the reasons for frequent hike in
prices of petroleum products recently;
(b) the number of times prices of these
products have been hiked during the last
three years and the hike in their prices;
(c) whether sometimes prices of these
products have also declined;
(d) if so, the details thereof'; and
(e) whether Government would take
any steps to reconsider the price hike made
in budget proposal and immediately
thereafter?

11
Petroleum price decontrol process
*38. SHRI AMBETH RAJAN: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has started the petroleum price decontrol
process;
(b) if so, what are the mechanisms to be
followed; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Enquiry into crash of flight IX-812 at
Mangalore
*39. SHRI M.P . ACHUTHAN: Will
the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has constituted
any enquiry into the crash of flight IX-812
at Mangalore that took place on 22 May,
2010 early morning;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government could ascertain
the causes of the accident;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether it is a fact that the runway
on the table top being a shorter one was
always a danger for the aircrafts like the ill-
fated one, as these require more distance
for landing safely; and
(f)  if so, the details thereof?
Dairy Development Project in Kangra
†*40. SHRI SHANTA KUMAR: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry had sanctioned
Dairy Development Project for Kangra
during the year 2001-02;
(b) the details of progress made in this
regard and the amount spent under the
scheme; and
(c) the details of increase in milk
production after this project?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 21st July, 2010 Secretary-General.
Asadha 30, 1932 (Saka)
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
